issues.legal_issue: Compensation for acquired agricultural land may reflect its potential value as a building site when the land’s situation and surrounding development support that potential and the valuation is supported by reliable comparable-sale evidence.
material_facts: The acquired land was agricultural and lay adjoining a railway track near a growing town.
The land had buildings on three sides and a metalled road on the fourth; railway staff quarters had been built on the land, and there was nearby construction.
The acquiring authority relied on a sale statement consisting mostly of older sales and produced no adequate evidence of comparable-site prices.
A sale of nearby, contiguous land shortly before the relevant valuation date was available as a guide to value.
issues.conclusion: The Court’s majority dismissed both appeals and upheld the enhanced compensation, finding no error in the valuation basis and no basis to regard the award as excessive or exorbitant.
issues.legal_principle: In determining compensation under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, the land’s potential as a building site is a question of fact assessed from its condition and situation, present or reasonably possible use, suitability for building, proximity to developed areas and institutions, available or extendable amenities, the town’s prospects, and pressure of building activity. In the section 18 reference and appeals concerning compensation under section 23, the majority accepted a nearby sale of contiguous land as a safe guide in light of the surrounding circumstances; an unsupported sale statement based mostly on old transactions was not adequate evidence. The majority did not rely on an earlier case.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_appeal and land_near_growing_town and (substantial_surrounding_development or nearby_building_activity) and reliable_comparable_sale_available

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning compensation for compulsorily acquired land.
predicates.land_near_growing_town: The acquired land is situated near a town that is growing or developing.
predicates.substantial_surrounding_development: Buildings, roads, or other development are present around the acquired land.
predicates.nearby_building_activity: Building activity has occurred on or near the acquired land.
predicates.reliable_comparable_sale_available: A genuine sale of nearby or contiguous land with similar advantages provides a reliable guide to value.

issues.definition: When a compensation appeal concerns land near a growing town, surrounding development or nearby building activity exists, and a reliable comparable sale is available, the compensation award is upheld.
